items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Don sent to New York and got Billy Taylor to come in Escudero's place. That's when I started fooling with the bass fiddle, when Billy Taylor was there.

ctx.x: Now, Escudero left, oh, not long -- I hadn't been in the band too long and Don sent to New York and got Billy Taylor to come in Escudero's place.
